name: flaggems_flash_attention_forward
description: Extracted from FlagGems flash_attention_forward. Vendor baseline torch.ops.aten._flash_attention_forward returning attention output and logsumexp. Inputs are laid out as (batch, seqlen, num_heads, head_size); q,k,v are drawn from uniform(-0.05, 0.05) as in the source make_input/input_fn.
reference:
import torch


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    q = torch.empty(
        ctx["q__shape"], dtype=getattr(torch, ctx["q__dtype"]), device=device
    ).uniform_(-0.05, 0.05)
    k = torch.empty(
        ctx["k__shape"], dtype=getattr(torch, ctx["k__dtype"]), device=device
    ).uniform_(-0.05, 0.05)
    v = torch.empty(
        ctx["v__shape"], dtype=getattr(torch, ctx["v__dtype"]), device=device
    ).uniform_(-0.05, 0.05)
    return {"q": q, "k": k, "v": v}


def run(q, k, v, scale, is_causal):
    out, lse, seed, offset, debug_softmax = torch.ops.aten._flash_attention_forward(
        q,
        k,
        v,
        None,
        None,
        q.shape[-3],
        k.shape[-3],
        0.0,
        is_causal,
        False,
        scale=scale,
    )
    return out, lse
